name: Future Mod
description: Skip level endings with a key, plus a per-level macro recorder with an automatic frame window counter (Click Between Frames supported).

skip-end.name: Exit Level Ending
skip-end.description: Press this while a level is finishing to instantly exit the level, skipping the end animation, the delay, and the completion screen. The level still counts as completed. Only active during the ending, so it's safe to set to your jump key (e.g. Space).

macro-enabled.name: Enable Macro Features
macro-enabled.description: Master switch for everything macro-related (recording, playback, the frame-perfect analyzer, the in-level menu, and the HUD). Turn this OFF to fully disable all macro functionality; the 'Exit Level Ending' keybind is unaffected.

macro-record.name: Macro: Record
macro-record.description: Toggle recording your inputs. Works with Click Between Frames: each click's exact position inside the physics step is captured, so the replay and the analysis reproduce what CBF actually did. Recording restarts on death, so it captures the attempt you complete. Don't use CBF's Physics Bypass.

macro-play.name: Macro: Play
macro-play.description: Toggle replaying the recorded macro from the start of the attempt.

macro-analyze.name: Macro: Analyze frame windows
macro-analyze.description: Measure every input's frame window: shift it earlier/later, re-run, and find the range that still survives. Results go to geode.log, the HUD, and export files (CSV + NaNDL JSON) in the macros folder (pause menu > Files). Don't touch the keyboard/mouse while it runs. Turn off noclip, speedhack and CBF Physics Bypass.

analyze-speed.name: Analyzer speed-up
analyze-speed.description: How fast to run the analysis. The analyzer tries this speed, and if a sped-up baseline doesn't reproduce your real 1x run tick-for-tick it automatically steps down (8x->4x->2x->1x) until it finds the fastest speed that stays exact. So a higher number is safe: it only ever speeds things up when it's provably identical to 1x. Long levels benefit most. For the biggest levels also enable 'Fast analysis'.

analyze-releases.name: Analyze releases too
analyze-releases.description: Also measure the timing window of RELEASES (letting go), not just presses. Wave/ship straight-flying is mostly release timing. Short taps are measured as one gesture either way. Turn off for cube-only levels to halve analysis time.

analyze-fast.name: Fast analysis (EXPERIMENTAL)
analyze-fast.description: Snapshots the game state before each input and restarts probes from there instead of replaying the whole level every time, so long levels analyze far faster (near-linear instead of quadratic). Every snapshot is first VERIFIED by re-running it unshifted and comparing against the baseline trajectory; any snapshot that drifts is discarded and that input falls back to the normal full-replay method automatically. EXPERIMENTAL: if counts still look wrong, compare with this OFF.

fw-max-window.name: Max window (frames)
fw-max-window.description: Windows wider than this many 240 Hz frames are reported as 'wide' (not a timing) and stop being probed. 10 matches NaN's lists; lower = faster analysis.

fw-subframe.name: Sub-frame precision (CBF)
fw-subframe.description: For inputs made with Click Between Frames, bisect each window edge this many times below one frame (3 = 1/8 frame, each step costs one extra run per edge). 0 = whole frames only. Has no effect on non-CBF runs, whose windows are always whole frames.

show-240.name: Show 240 FPS
show-240.description: While analyzing, show the frame-perfect count at 240 (window <= 1 tick) in the top-right corner.

show-120.name: Show 120 FPS
show-120.description: While analyzing, show the frame-perfect count at 120 (window <= 2 ticks) in the top-right corner.

show-60.name: Show 60 FPS
show-60.description: While analyzing, show the frame-perfect count at 60 (window <= 4 ticks) in the top-right corner.

fw-rings.name: Frame window rings
fw-rings.description: During macro playback (K), draw a ring on the player at every analyzed click and release, the moment it happens, labelled with its frame window and coloured by it (red = tight, green = loose; pink = sub-frame with CBF). A counter in the top-left shows how many inputs of each window you've passed so far. Same display as NaN GD's frame window videos. Run the analyzer (N) once first so the windows are known.

fw-ring-pop.name: Ring pop-in animation
fw-ring-pop.description: Rings scale up quickly when they appear. Turn off to have them appear instantly at full size.

fw-ring-size.name: Ring size
fw-ring-size.description: How big the rings (and their window numbers) are. 1 = normal, 0.5 = half, 2 = double. Changes apply live, even to rings already on screen.

fw-sound.name: Frame window sound
fw-sound.description: Play a sound on every analyzed input during playback. Its pitch follows the window: a 1-frame input is the lowest note and each extra frame steps it up, so you can hear how tight a section is.

fw-sound-file.name: Sound file
fw-sound-file.description: A GD sound name (e.g. counter003.ogg, playSound_01.ogg), a file you put in this mod's config folder, or a full path to an .ogg/.mp3/.wav. Falls back to playSound_01.ogg if it can't be found.

fw-sound-volume.name: Sound volume
fw-sound-volume.description: Volume of the frame window sound (also scaled by GD's SFX volume).

ghost-fidelity.name: Ghost fidelity probe
ghost-fidelity.description: OPTIONAL DIAGNOSTIC, not needed for the frame window counter. DIAGNOSTIC. Every 120 ticks of normal play, simulate a copy of the player 60 ticks ahead and compare it against what you actually do. Writes [fw] GHOSTFID lines to geode.log and a PHASE1 ... VERDICT=PASS/FAIL line when you die or quit. This decides whether the new frame-window counter can measure sub-frame windows at all. Costs nothing visually; turn it off when you're done testing.

ghost-order.name: Ghost step order
ghost-order.description: Which reconstruction of GD's physics step the simulation uses. GD's real internal ordering can't be read from the game, so this is tested by trial: run the fidelity probe once on each of 0, 1 and 2 and keep whichever gives the smallest maxdx. 0 = collide, move, rotate (what every other trajectory mod uses). 1 = move, collide, rotate. 2 = collide, move, special, rotate.

ghost-eps.name: Ghost tolerance (units)
ghost-eps.description: How far the simulated player may drift from the real one before it counts as diverged. Used by the fidelity probe's divergeAt column.

timestamp-probe.name: Timestamp clock probe
timestamp-probe.description: OPTIONAL DIAGNOSTIC, not needed for the frame window counter. DIAGNOSTIC. Logs 100 [fw] TSPROBE lines at the start of a level showing the game's internal input timestamp. Answers one question: whether GD's own between-steps input path can be driven at an exact sub-tick time, which would let windows be measured below one frame in the real engine. One run is enough, ever.

log-verbose.name: Verbose logging
log-verbose.description: Write per-tick detail to geode.log. Very noisy; only enable when asked for a detailed log.
